name: 90249 · Gardena, CA
findings: ZIP 90249 (Gardena) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90249 (Gardena) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
